question: In a ΔABC, points P, Q and R are taken on AB, BC and CA, respectively, such that BQ = PQ and QC = QR. If ∠BAC = 75º, what is the measure of ∠PQR (in degrees)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/626ab74d9ea5000cf727fc54c65f1619ee6984d00c3e11ea54b5c299b076fd9c.png] 

∠BAC = 75º

∠ABC + ∠ACB + ∠BAC = 180°

∠ABC + ∠ACB + 75° = 180°

∠ABC + ∠ACB = 180° - 75° = 105°

Let, ∠ABC = ∠PBQ = 70° and ∠ACB = ∠RCQ = 35°

So, ∠PQR = 180° - (∠PQB + ∠RQC)

= 180° - [(180° - 2∠PBQ) + (180° - 2∠RCQ) [∵ BQ = PQ; QC = QR]

= 180° - [(180° - 2 × 70°) + (180° - 2 × 35°)]

= 180° - (40° + 110°)

= 180° - 150°

= 30°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In a ΔABC, ∠BAC = 75º

BQ = PQ and QC = QR

**Concept used:**

The sum of all three angles of a triangle = 180°

The sum of all angles on a straight line = 180°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/626ab74d9ea5000cf727fc54c65f1619ee6984d00c3e11ea54b5c299b076fd9c.png] 

Let, ∠ABC = x and ∠ACB = y

So, ∠ABC = ∠PBQ = ∠QPB = x [∵ BQ = PQ]

∠ACB = ∠RCQ = ∠QRC = y [QC = QR]

In ΔABC, ∠ABC + ∠ACB + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ x + y + 75° = 180°

⇒ x + y = 180° - 75° = 105° .....(1)

For ΔBPQ and ΔCRQ,

(∠PBQ + ∠QPB + ∠PQB) + (∠RCQ + ∠QRC + ∠RQC) = 180° + 180° = 360°

⇒ (x + x + ∠PQB) + (y + y + ∠RQC) = 360°

⇒ 2x + 2y + ∠PQB + ∠RQC = 360°

⇒ 2 (x + y) + ∠PQB + ∠RQC = 360°

⇒ (2 × 105°) + ∠PQB + ∠RQC = 360° [∵ x + y = 105°]

⇒ ∠PQB + ∠RQC = 360° - 210° = 150° .....(2)

Also, ∠PQB + ∠RQC + ∠PQR = 180°

⇒ 150° + ∠PQR = 180° [∵ ∠PQB + ∠RQC = 150°]

⇒ ∠PQR = 180° - 150° = 30°

**∴ The measure of ∠PQR (in degrees) is 30°**
